content: DMN Conformance Level 3 (highest) requires Clauses 6 (DRG/DRD notation), 7 (decision logic: boxed expressions, item definitions, info items), 8 (decision tables: notation, hit policies, default outputs), and 10 (full FEEL: grammar, all boxed expressions, built-in functions, decision service execution semantics, XML data mapping). Level 1 = clauses 6,7,8 only (no expression interpretation). Level 2 = + S-FEEL (Clause 9, subset for decision tables). Level 3 = + full FEEL (Clause 10). All levels must comply with Clause 2.2 (visual appearance, decision semantics, attributes). No partial claims allowed - must fully match compliance points. S-FEEL is subset of FEEL so Level 3 implies Level 2+1.
